channel.title: Articles — CA Sunil Kumar, FCA
channel.description: Articles on NGO governance, FCRA compliance, strategic finance and building a wealthy, resilient life.

item.title: Nonprofit Risk Register: A Practical Guide for Boards
item.description: How a nonprofit or NGO builds a risk register its Board actually uses: the 8 risk areas, how to score likelihood and impact, a worked example, and the mistakes that make registers useless.

item.title: FCRA Renewal Checklist: 10 Checks Before You Apply
item.description: FCRA registration lasts five years and renewal must be applied for in the last six months. Ten checks NGOs should run first, including the new ₹10 lakh reasonable activity test.

item.title: What FCRA Non-Compliance Really Costs an NGO
item.description: FCRA non-compliance costs more than a compounding fee: frozen funds, suspension, cancellation, lost staff and donor trust. The cost ladder, where it starts, and the prevention budget.

item.title: NGO Donor Due-Diligence Checklist: What Funders Check
item.description: What foundations, CSR teams and international donors check before funding an NGO: a 10-area due-diligence checklist, the red flags, and how to keep a ready pack.

item.title: Effective Procurement: Beyond Compliance to Governance, Culture and Programme Impact
item.description: Why procurement failures persist despite sound policies, and what fixes them: leadership by example, governance, culture, root-cause diagnosis, fair accountability and links to programme results.

item.title: FCRA Administrative Expenses: Managing Within the 20% Limit
item.description: FCRA caps administrative expenses at 20% of foreign contribution received. Rule 5 classification, the one-year carry-forward, domestic funding for overheads and a monthly MIS, with a free 9-page PDF guide.

item.title: FC-4 Annual Return 2025–26: 10 Checks Before 31 December
item.description: FC-4 for 2025–26 is due by 31 December 2026, with new disclosures from the FCRA Amendment Rules 2026. Ten checks NGOs should run now, who owns each, and a timeline.

item.title: Is Your FCRA Problem Really a Compliance Problem? What Three Governance Assessments Showed
item.description: Three FCRA governance assessments: compliance scored highest (3.52/5), risk, resilience and continuity lowest (2.23/5). What boards should ask, and do, differently.

item.title: FCRA Amendment Rules 2026: What NGOs Need to Know
item.description: FCRA Amendment Rules 2026 explained for NGOs: purpose and State-wise registration, FC-6F by June 2027, key functionaries, ultimate donors and FC-4 changes.

item.title: The Wealthy Life: Building Wealth That Lasts Beyond Success
item.description: Why success does not guarantee a wealthy life: income vs wealth, six dimensions of wealth, return on effort, and turning success into resilience.
